extension.description: Accessible CSV reading for people with color vision differences, with column numbers, headers, and keyboard navigation.
command.nextRow: Go to Next Row in Current Column
command.previousRow: Go to Previous Row in Current Column
configuration.hasHeader: Use the first CSV record as column headers.
configuration.columnFocus: Focus the current cell or its column with visible marks. Off removes the marks.
configuration.statusBar: Show the current logical CSV row, column, and header in the status bar.
